g.text: West cove — back and contact construction reference
Original schematic, metres / Y up. Supplements board shots 3–4; design intent, not measured image geometry.
BACK: buried mating plane, 4 m module
Flat rear; embed into the shared heightfield.
Beds share world Y; yaw/width may vary, no vertical stretching.
SECTION: grass / seam / face / foot / shelf
Same triangles render and collide; buried rear cannot block a cave.
No cave. Bench continues below sea (blue); rock top is an obstacle.
Contact detail: broad chamfer, shallow recess, irregular bed edge; no grit or repeated masonry joints.
Waterline blocks: rounded 6–8 sided sections; dry scree: fewer angular facets, partly buried.
Resolve shot 4's regular wall by bending the headland and burying ends; retain shot 2's open beach.
